note: Export shipments are factually confirmed by dated customs/B-L records, not by website claims: leather safety gloves under HS 42032910 (the declared HS 420329 is the 6-digit parent of the same heading, so no HS correction is needed) shipped ex Kolkata Sea to Venezuela (24.02.2026, BOL 9971195) and Israel (04.02.2026, BOL 9381589), with RODTEP claims and E-seal, plus a granite slab export to Morocco (26.02.2026, HS 68029300, BOL 1044519). Role: trader/manufacturer_trader — the entity both exports gloves and imports polyester fabric, so it is a multi-commodity trading house rather than a single-line producer. Caution on identity: 'OVERSEAS IMPEX' is a very common Indian trade name and the ImportKey aggregate (405 shipments, 17 partners) may merge several distinct legal entities (e.g. a Kolkata glove exporter and a Chennai granite exporter appear under one name); the claimed state Maharashtra is not corroborated by the records seen, which point to Kolkata Sea (INCCU1) and Chennai Sea (INMAA1). No CIN/PAN or GSTIN was public in the sources read, so legal-entity identity and domestic turnover remain null — not invented. Industry claim 'food/FMCG' is not supported by any record seen; the observed trade is leather PPE gloves, granite and polyester fabric.
